title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel; who they are.
text:
⟨p.125⟩
ⲛ̄
Concerning the {12} 'rich god'
and angel: what are they? {14}
Once {15} the Illuminator said: 'This (one) to whom name is given in
the cosmos, with the men uttering it with their mouths — "rich god
{16}and angel": what are they? What are the gods? Or
{17} are the rich ones? Or what are the angels? What are these
{18} types?' The disciples asked him, questioning him about it:
'{19} us, our Lord, what are they?'
{20} to them: 'These three types exist
{21} them.
Those whom they call {22}
⟨p.126⟩
to them, saying: 'They are gods of gods,' whom the Father summoned
through himself, alone — he set {1} upright before the likeness
of his Greatness.
These also, those whom they name —
{2} rich' — it is the call of the first gods,
the rich {3} the Father, to the people. When the {4}
they themselves made a calling of callings; they named them
'rich.' They themselves, the rich, they made a
calling; they named them 'angels.' These are the three
{5}pes that exist in the land of light, with no measure to give to
them.
Once again, hear him: another visage,
those whom {6} name 'gods' are the emanations who
came forth from the Father in the call of the Father, who summoned them out
from him; they came forth to the contest; they brought low the Enmity.
The 'rich' itself is the {8}all of the first living word.
They themselves, the rich, they came, they wrought, they fulfilled the purpose
of heart of the Greatness {9} worlds that are above and
below. Those whom they themselves name 'angels' —
it is the call of the rich-ones who came forth from the three
living words — those who were sent in an embassy and
an apostolate to the Building, those who came to the whole godhood
that stands fast in stillness and in concord. {10}
were able also to come to all the souls who had been transmuted in the {11}
they brought to them the hope and the trust.
Once {12}
the Illuminator said: those whom they name {13} also {14}' —
it is all the gods reckoned to the house of the Greatness, of the Spirit.
Those whom they themselves name 'angels' — it is all the angels {15}
reckoned to the house of the Beloved of Lights.
Those whom they name
'rich' — it is all the rich-ones reckoned to the house {16}
ssador, who is of glory.
